problem_type: Smoke harness confuses elapsed time with asynchronous route readiness and reuses historical evidence paths
symptom: Smoke62 observes creation momentarily, then fails generation visibility on a Suspense spinner; root failure.json/png are overwritten by new runs.
direct_cause: Project and tab transitions use fixed sleeps followed by immediate snapshots, and evidenceDir is the shared historical root.
class_root: Smoke progress must depend on bounded observed completion from the existing assertion owner, and evidence identity must belong to a unique run.

structural_evidence.behavior_preservation: All original smoke assertions, selectors, helpers, geometry thresholds, URL/project identity and capture names remain. Replace only causally audited UI sleeps with canonical bounded conditions. Root evidence stays historical; mkdtemp basename isolates each run under the same recursively uploaded parent. No configurable arbitrary output path.
structural_evidence.verification_limits: Only static/source-fragment owner tests and existing Node waiting guard, no App/browser or heavy suite. Canonical poll is real, locator samples are deterministic fixtures; actual smoke acceptance belongs to coordinator's App rerun. No production, budget, timeout-default, baseline, global setup, skip or user-memory changes.
